test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The FIFA cup 2022 will be won by France.

options.text: France will be winning the FIFA cup 2022.
France would win the FIFA cup 2022.
France will win the FIFA cup 2022.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "France will win the FIFA cup 2022."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the FIFA cup 2022" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will win" to "will be won" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "France."
 
• Ensure the sentence structure remains clear and accurate.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"France will win the FIFA cup 2022."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"France will be winning the FIFA cup 2022." – Incorrect tense (future continuous active).
 
• **Option 2: **"France wins the FIFA cup 2022." – Incorrect tense (present simple active).
 
• **Option 3: **"France would win the FIFA cup 2022." – Incorrect modal verb (conditional).
